title: Amazing Thabo Midnight Marathon 2027: Thailand's Border-Town Race Under the Stars
seo_title: Amazing Thabo Midnight Marathon 2027 Review | Nong Khai Guide
meta_description: An early look at the Amazing Thabo Midnight Marathon, set for May 1, 2027 in Tha Bo, Nong Khai, Thailand. Four distances, a midnight start, and registration is already open — here's what to expect.
dek: Set for 1 May 2027 in Tha Bo, Nong Khai — a Mekong-side town on the Thai–Lao border — this midnight marathon offers four distances from 5km to the full 42.195km. Registration is already open. Here's the early intelligence on one of Thailand's more unusual race concepts.
verdict: The Amazing Thabo Midnight Marathon is one of the more distinctive entries on Thailand's 2027 calendar: a midnight-start race in a Mekong River border town that most international runners have never heard of. Four distances from 5km to the full marathon make it accessible across abilities, and the fact that registration is already open — in August 2026, nine months ahead of race day — signals an organiser that wants to lock in its field early. The midnight format is a genuine heat-management strategy for Thailand's May climate, and the Nong Khai province setting, overlooking Laos across the Mekong, gives it a sense of place that a generic city race can't match. Suits runners who want an unusual Thai race experience off the tourist trail; not for those who need a slick, big-city production.

sections.heading: The Concept: A Midnight Marathon on the Mekong
paragraphs: A midnight marathon in Thailand isn't unheard of — the Bangkok Midnight Marathon runs in December — but a midnight-start full marathon in Nong Khai, a province on the Mekong River bordering Laos, is a genuinely unusual proposition. [1] The midnight start is both a practical heat strategy and a defining feature: running through the small hours in a border town means empty roads, cooler temperatures, and a finish around sunrise.

The race is organised by Thabo Marathon and held in Tha Bo, a district of Nong Khai province. [1] Nong Khai itself is best known as the Thai gateway to Vientiane — the Lao capital sits just across the Thai–Lao Friendship Bridge — and the province has a sleepy, river-town character that's a world away from Thailand's beach-resort or big-city race scenes.

sections.heading: The Distances: Four Options, Full Marathon as Headliner
paragraphs: The event offers four distances: a full marathon (42.195km), half marathon (21.1km), 10km, and 5km. [1] The full marathon is the primary distance, which makes sense for a midnight race — the format suits the longer distance, where runners benefit most from cooler overnight temperatures.

For runners not ready for a full marathon, the half and 10km options provide accessible on-ramps while still letting participants experience the midnight-start format. The 5km rounds out the field for community participants and first-timers.

sections.heading: Registration: Open Now, Nine Months Ahead
paragraphs: Unlike most 2027 races currently on the calendar, registration for the Amazing Thabo Midnight Marathon is already open. [1] That's a notable point of difference — most Thai races, especially smaller regional events, open registration three to six months before race day. The early opening suggests an organiser that wants to build its field gradually and lock in committed runners well ahead of race week.

The official site at thabomarathon.com handles registration, and the race is also listed on aggregator platforms including AIMS and Race Result Asia. [1] Early-bird pricing isn't detailed in the current listing, but the open-registration window gives runners planning a 2027 calendar a concrete entry option rather than a placeholder.

sections.heading: The Setting: Tha Bo, Nong Khai — A Border-Town Race
paragraphs: Tha Bo is a district town in Nong Khai province, roughly 30km west of Nong Khai city and the Thai–Lao Friendship Bridge. The Mekong River defines the northern edge of the province, and the landscape is flat river plain — expect a road course with Mekong views rather than hills. [1]

Getting there requires a bit more planning than a Bangkok or Phuket race. The nearest airport with regular service is Udon Thani, roughly 80km south, which connects to Bangkok and a handful of regional destinations. From Udon Thani, it's a straightforward drive north to Nong Khai and then west to Tha Bo. Vientiane, Laos is also accessible — fly into Vientiane and cross the Friendship Bridge into Nong Khai, then drive to Tha Bo. It's a travel commitment, but the border-town setting is part of the draw.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: If you want a Thai marathon with a genuinely distinctive format — midnight start, Mekong River backdrop, border-town atmosphere — the Amazing Thabo Midnight Marathon is worth a close look. The fact that registration is already open makes it one of the few 2027 races you can actually sign up for today. [1]

The trade-off is organiser profile: Thabo Marathon is not a household name in Thai road racing, and independent runner reports from previous editions are scarce. Go in expecting a community-flavoured event rather than a slick production, and treat the midnight format and the Nong Khai setting as the main event. The 2027 edition is set for 1 May in Tha Bo, Nong Khai, Thailand. [1]
